title: Pure Nitro
summary: Yusei Fudo's Nitro strategy centers around Level 2 FIRE Machine Tuner Nitro Synchron and its explosive Level 7 FIRE Warrior Synchro boss, Nitro Warrior! Whenever you activate a Spell Card during your turn, Nitro Warrior gains 1000 ATK (to 3800 ATK) during the next attack it makes, and when Nitro Warrior destroys an opponent's monster by battle, it switches 1 face-up Defense Position monster your opponent controls to Attack Position and attacks it immediately in a row! Pair Level 2 Nitro Synchron with Level 5 self-summoning non-Tuners (Quickdraw Synchron, Wheel Synchron, and Super Quantum Red Layer) or Revolution Synchron to Synchro Summon Level 7 Nitro Warrior while drawing cards and triggering Spell-boosted double attacks!

allow.Super Quantum Red Layer: Level 5 FIRE Warrior that Special Summons itself from your hand when you control no monsters; Normal Summoning Level 2 Nitro Synchron right next to it immediately Synchro Summons Level 7 Nitro Warrior (2 + 5 = 7) AND draws 1 card from Nitro Synchron!
allow.Synchro Overtake: Limited to 1 in TCG: reveals 'Nitro Warrior' in your Extra Deck to add 'Nitro Synchron' directly from your Deck or GY to your hand (or Special Summon it) AND triggers Nitro Warrior's +1000 ATK Spell boost!
allow.Synchro Chase: Continuous Spell that revives Nitro Synchron or Nitro Warrior from your GY whenever you Synchro Summon a 'Warrior' or 'Synchron' Synchro Monster, and prevents your opponent from responding to your Warrior Synchros!
allow.Scrap-Iron Signal: Counter Trap that negates an opponent's monster effect while you control a Synchro Monster that lists a 'Synchron' Tuner as material (Nitro Warrior!) and resets itself face-down instead of going to the GY!
allow.Junk Converter: Level 2 EARTH Warrior non-Tuner: discards itself and 1 Tuner to add ANY 'Synchron' monster from your Deck to your hand; and when used as Synchro Material alongside Level 5 Quickdraw Synchron, revives Nitro Synchron from your GY!
allow.Doppelwarrior: Level 2 DARK Warrior non-Tuner: Special Summons itself from your hand when a monster is revived from your GY, and pairs with Level 5 Quickdraw Synchron for Level 7 Nitro Warrior while spawning 2 Doppel Tokens!
allow.Junk Speeder: Level 5 Warrior Synchro that Special Summons Nitro Synchron, Revolution Synchron, and Wheel Synchron directly from your Deck!
allow.Jet Warrior: Level 5 FIRE Warrior Synchro made with Quickdraw Synchron or Nitro Synchron that bounces an opponent's card on Synchro Summon.
allow.Stardust Charge Warrior: Level 6 Warrior Synchro that draws 1 card on Synchro Summon.
allow.Crystal Wing Synchro Dragon: Level 8 Synchro boss that negates monster effects and overwhelms high-Level threats in battle.

main: Nitro Synchron
Signature Level 2 FIRE Machine Tuner: whenever this card is sent to the GY for the Synchro Summon of a 'Nitro' Synchro Monster (Nitro Warrior!), you immediately draw 1 card!
Quickdraw Synchron

Level 5 WIND Machine Tuner: sends 1 monster from your hand to the GY to Special Summon itself, and can substitute for ANY 'Synchron' Tuner (including substituting for 'Nitro Synchron' to Synchro Summon Level 7 Nitro Warrior alongside any Level 2 non-Tuner!).
Revolution Synchron
Level 3 EARTH Machine Tuner: can be used from your HAND as Synchro Material for a Level 7 or 8 Synchro Monster, then mills 1 card to revive itself from the GY as a Level 1 Tuner!
Wheel Synchron

Level 5 LIGHT Machine non-Tuner/Tuner: can be treated as a NON-Tuner for a Synchro Summon (pairing with Level 2 Nitro Synchron for Level 7 Nitro Warrior!), and grants an extra Normal Summon of a Level 4 or lower monster.
Junk Converter

Level 2 EARTH Warrior non-Tuner: discards itself and 1 Tuner to add ANY 'Synchron' monster from your Deck to your hand; and when used as Synchro Material alongside Level 5 Quickdraw Synchron, revives Nitro Synchron from your GY!
Doppelwarrior

Level 2 DARK Warrior non-Tuner: Special Summons itself from your hand when a monster is revived from your GY, and pairs with Level 5 Quickdraw Synchron for Level 7 Nitro Warrior while spawning 2 Doppel Tokens!
Super Quantum Red Layer

Level 5 FIRE Warrior that Special Summons itself when you control no monsters—pairing with Normal Summoned Level 2 Nitro Synchron for an instant Level 7 Nitro Warrior (2 + 5 = 7) while drawing 1 card!
Tuning

Adds any 'Synchron' Tuner (Nitro Synchron, Quickdraw Synchron, or Revolution Synchron) from your Deck to your hand and mills the top card of your Deck; also triggers Nitro Warrior's +1000 ATK Spell boost!
Synchro Overtake
Limited to 1 in TCG: reveals 'Nitro Warrior' in your Extra Deck to add 'Nitro Synchron' from your Deck or GY to your hand (or Special Summon it!), and triggers Nitro Warrior's +1000 ATK boost!
Synchro Chase

Continuous Spell: whenever you Synchro Summon Nitro Warrior, revives Nitro Synchron from your GY AND prevents your opponent from activating cards or effects in response to your Warrior Synchro Monsters' effect activations!
Scrap-Iron Signal
Counter Trap: while you control a Synchro Monster that lists a 'Synchron' Tuner as material (Nitro Warrior!), negates an opponent's monster effect activation and Sets itself back face-down!
extra: Signature Level 7 FIRE Warrior Synchro boss ('Nitro Synchron' + 1+ non-Tuner monsters; 2800 ATK): once during each of your turns, if you activate a Spell Card, this card gains 1000 ATK (to 3800 ATK!) during the next attack; if this attacking card destroys an opponent's monster by battle, switches 1 Defense monster to Attack and attacks it in a row!
